tasks.short: Transport materials, products, or samples to the next area.

steps.what: Move them manually or with conveyors, pumps, or trucks
Sign the move to processing, shipping, or storage

outputs: filed copy of signed move v1

tasks.design: Transporting materials, products, or samples to processing, shipping, or storage areas stays with the weigher, manually or with conveyors, pumps, or hand trucks. A job files the move in {ERP} only after the weigher signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A status could say goods had moved when they were still on the dock.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed move can be filed on the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: The goods still have to be moved by a person.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher moves the goods and signs the move.
tasks.altitude: The transport stays. Filing the signed move shrinks.

reach.task: Expect the goods only at the signed area

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not move goods.
Nothing is filed as moved before signature.
unknowns: Which loads a person may move alone.
research_questions: How often the next area is full.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the transport step is the moving itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every load is still moved by the weigher. The high end assumes only the signed move is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

outputs: filed copy of signed unload v1

tasks.design: Unloading and unpacking incoming shipments stays with the weigher. A job files the unload in {ERP} only after the weigher signs it. The job does not unload a truck.
tasks.previous_blocker: A receipt could say a shipment was unpacked when the truck was still closed.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed unload can be filed on the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: The goods still have to come off the truck by hand.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher unloads and signs that they did.
tasks.altitude: The unload stays. Filing the signed unload shrinks.

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not unload or unpack.
unknowns: Which shipments the weigher may open.
research_questions: How often a shipment arrives damaged before it is unpacked.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the unload step is the unloading itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every shipment is still unloaded by the weigher. The high end assumes only the signed unload is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The weigher spends the shift on the scale, the sample, and the check. A captured quantity can be filed after they sign it. The scale's own readout is not saved human time.
reach: A supervisor sees a shortage only from the note the weigher signed.
The laboratory receives the sample the weigher prepared, not a generated result.
skills_to_grow: Tell a scale readout from a quantity they are willing to sign.
Refuse a tally that names a worker as the cause of a defect.
role.ambitious_version: A signed quantity can be on the shipping record the same shift, and the weigher still signs it.

job.title: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
